svg.title: Buy a product — nominal path
svg.desc: ◇ Checkout decision → nominal (nominal) → Place an order 1.1. buyer to checkout, orders:cart: Submit the cart for checkout 1.2. checkout to pricing, orders:priced-cart: Price the cart with current promotions 1.3. pricing to checkout, orders:quote: Return the priced quote ◇ Payment decision → charged (nominal) → Take payment 2.1. checkout to payment-gateway, orders:charge: Request the charge from the payment gateway 2.2. payment-gateway to checkout, orders:charge-result: Report whether the charge succeeded 2.3. checkout to checkout, orders:paid: Record the order as paid ◇ Fulfilment decision → ship (nominal) → Ship the order 3.1. checkout to fulfilment, orders:paid: Hand the paid order to fulfilment 3.2. fulfilment to carrier, orders:shipment: Book the shipment with the carrier 3.3. fulfilment to buyer, orders:tracking: Send tracking to the buyer ■ outcome: shipped
